posts.author: tsurugikage
posts.body:
So I want to try and edit my gave to use my actors/enemies defense stats instead of their agility stats.
I'm not sure if this is something i can do in rpg maker, or if I need coding experience. Or if there's a plugin for that,  I'm not aware of its existence

posts.author: TobyYasha
tsurugikage
posts.body: I'm not sure if it worked or not. Does it matter if I am using Visustella Plugins like the Battle Core?

posts.author: TobyYasha
rpgLord69
posts.body: Yeah they have a spot in the BattleCore mechanics settings where you can adjust the escape ratio with code. So you could also just use that part that calculates the total defences of the troops and then change the 'agility()' in the plugin settings to 'defense()'.

posts.author: tsurugikage
posts.body:
So I did try this out. again They actors are always able to run away.
I even made it so the actors had 1 defense each, while their opponents have 100 defense each
So the Total should be
(0.5*2)/200
which should be 1/200 for the ratio, making it a very slim chance if there are 2 actors and 2 enemy troops.
Yet the actors keep being able to run away.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Hmmm, is your VisuStella Core Engine settings set to: Quality of Life Settings - Escape Always true?

posts.author: tsurugikage
posts.body:
rpgLord69 said:
Hmmm, is your VisuStella Core Engine settings set to: Quality of Life Settings - Escape Always true?
Click to expand...
I didn't realize that was an option.
I have turned it off and it works now

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Cool.
VS BattleCore also makes the escape chance rise after failure by default. The code to modify that is under the escape ratio part in the settings.
